client.description: Who asks for the review (package 0.1.48), as the client declares it. Display data the sidecar does not check: the review window names the client and uses its language. A value the sidecar cannot use is dropped, not refused.

platform.description: The client's surface, its X-Erato-Platform value such as web or outlook.

locale.description: The client's active language as a BCP-47 tag.
